title: Toxicity in Multilingual Machine Translation at Scale

bias_targets.methodology: Translating template-based sentences containing sexual orientation descriptors (from the HOLISTICBIAS dataset) into 164 languages and measuring added toxicity in the outputs using language-specific wordlist-based detectors.
Translating sentences with gender and sex descriptors into multiple languages and identifying added toxicity in the machine translation outputs using toxicity wordlists and ALTI+ input attributions.
Evaluating machine translation outputs for added toxicity when translating English sentences containing ability, disability, and cognitive impairment descriptors into 164 languages.
Analyzing translation outputs for added toxicity and potentially racist color associations when translating sentences with race and ethnicity descriptors.
Assessing added toxicity and xenophobic translations when processing sentences containing national-origin and nationality descriptors.
Detecting added toxicity in translations of sentences containing socioeconomic descriptors (e.g., terms connoting poverty) using wordlist-based toxicity detectors.
Measuring the introduction of toxic terms in translation outputs for sentences containing physical body type descriptors.
Measuring added toxicity in machine translation outputs across 164 languages for sentences containing age-related demographic descriptors.
Evaluating added toxicity in multilingual translations of sentences containing religious descriptors from the HOLISTICBIAS dataset.
Detecting added toxicity in the translated outputs of sentences containing political ideology descriptors.
Measuring the introduction of toxicity when translating sentences with cultural demographic descriptors into 164 different languages.
